core_principles: Protect capital first: avoid forcing entries in weak/uncertain conditions.
A loss is feedback: reduce confidence and size in repeated losing patterns.
Prefer setups aligned with higher-timeframe bias unless confidence is exceptional.
Wait for confirmation and acceptable spread/slippage.
improvement_loop: Record closed outcomes with session/hour/side context.
Penalize side-hour combinations with persistent loss rates.
Escalate penalty on repeated losses for the same side.
Use rolling outcomes for drift alerts.

definitions.loss: A closed trade where net_pnl_zar < 0 (profit + swap + commission).

quarantine_summary.reason: Only broker deals tagged with Atlas magic/comment or linked to an Atlas-owned position can enter learning.

candidates.explainability_summary: trend edge is usable; performance is not range-dependent; stop-hunt vulnerability is controlled

pattern_comparison.main_signal_gap: Winning trades tend to appear with stronger trend strength and better confidence than losing trades.

m1_training_summary.policy_note: Training evidence only; no live risk or execution policy changed.
